Section 1. Title and Purpose
A. This Act shall be known as the Synthetic Lantern Coverage Act.
Drafting Note: A state may choose another title for this invented Act.

Section 2. Definitions
As used in this Act:
A. "Commissioner" means the commissioner of insurance of this state.
Drafting Note: Insert the title of the invented official here. This note runs
on for a second line and is not law.
B. "Lantern" means a portable lamp insured under [insert citation to lamp code].
(1) A lantern kept under [citation to specific statute] is covered.
2
National Council of Insurance Legislators (NCOIL)
(2) A lantern kept in [this state] is covered.

Section 3. Lantern Coverage
An insurer [shall][may] cover a lantern for [60] days.
Legislative Note: An invented note on coverage, which runs
over two lines.

The commissioner may adopt rules to carry out this section.

Section 4. Severability
If any provision of this Act is held invalid, the remainder is not affected.
